headline: Sociedad need a win in Norway; the market expects a one-goal margin
summary: Real Sociedad have 1 point from their opening two Europa League games and sit 22nd of 36, so Thursday's trip to Lillestrom already matters. Lillestrom won the Norwegian cup and play at home, but they lost 0-3 at Viking in September and gave up 2.95 expected goals at home to Molde. Sociedad are not whole: midfielder Herrera, 622 minutes this season, is doubtful with a calf problem, and right-back Aramburu is out. The market still makes the away side 63% favourites, rated 1.09 goals better — which points to a one-goal win rather than a rout. The goals line is 3.0.
read: Real Sociedad are clear favourites in Lillestrom, rated about a goal the better side, but they arrive with one point from two Europa League games and a doubt over their most-used midfielder. The market expects an open game of around three goals, and Lillestrom — Norwegian cup winners from the second tier — will need to defend far better than in the 2-2 with Molde, when they gave up 2.95 xG.

facts.fact: Real Sociedad are 63.1% to win at Lillestrom, more than three and a half times the home side's 17.2%.
facts.meaning: The market makes the away side clear favourites on a Norwegian away night.

facts.fact: Real Sociedad have one point from their two Europa League games — a 1-2 home defeat to Bournemouth and a 1-1 draw at Union St. Gilloise.
facts.meaning: They sit 22nd of 36 and need a win here to avoid playing catch-up in the league phase.

facts.fact: Lillestrom won 2-0 at Sandefjord on Sunday but were out-created 0.51 to 1.35 on xG.
facts.meaning: The scoreline flattered them: two goals from very little, and plenty of chances given up.

facts.fact: The handicap line is Lillestrom +1, with the market's fair line moving from 1.04 to 1.09 goals in Sociedad's favour.
facts.meaning: The market calls this a one-goal Sociedad win rather than a rout — a single-goal margin lands exactly on the line.

facts.fact: Midfielder Y. Herrera, Real Sociedad's most-used player this season with 622 minutes in 10 appearances, is doubtful with a calf injury, and right-back J. Aramburu is out with a leg problem.
facts.meaning: Sociedad may have to reshape both midfield and right-back for a game they are expected to control.

facts.fact: Lillestrom are without attacker C. Jebara, who has 329 minutes in 11 appearances this season, and defender E. B. Garnas, out with a knee injury.
facts.meaning: The home squad loses attacking and defensive cover before its biggest home night of the autumn.

facts.fact: The total-goals line is 3.0, with the fair line at 2.89.
facts.meaning: The market expects an open game of about three goals, with under 3.0 only a narrow favourite.

facts.fact: Lillestrom won the 2025 Norwegian cup while still a second-division club and are managed by Hans Erik Odegaard, Martin Odegaard's father.
facts.meaning: A cup-winning, newly promoted side with a home crowd and nothing to lose on a European night.

sources.fact: Hans Erik Odegaard, father of Martin Odegaard, is the Lillestrom coach and has imposed a more associative style at the club.
Odegaard led Lillestrom out of the Norwegian second division and made them cup champions.
Lillestrom won the 2025 Norwegian cup in December while still a second-division team and now compete in the top flight.
Lillestrom have had a poor start in Europe despite earning a creditable point.
Lillestrom got through their league match at Sandefjord before turning attention to Real Sociedad.
The match will be played at the roughly 700-away-seat Arasen Stadion in Lillestrom.
Real Sociedad arrive at Arasen having scored 13 goals in their last five official matches, though they have taken only one point in that run.
This is Real Sociedad's third match of the Europa League league phase.

key_points: Market sees Sociedad by a goal
